16.eng: While in the hospital following the loss of the young couple’s twin baby, the new mother received a priesthood blessing. The husband, however, did not. After our dinner together, I had the opportunity to give this grieving father a priesthood blessing. Through the whisperings of the Spirit, he was promised peace “which passeth all understanding” during this difficult time and throughout his life. As he and his wife left that evening, their countenances shone with the light of the One in whom we must all put our complete trust.

16.spa: Mientras se encontraba en el hospital tras la pérdida del bebé gemelo de la joven pareja, la reciente madre recibió una bendición del sacerdocio. Sin embargo, el esposo no. Después de nuestra cena con ellos, tuve la oportunidad de darle una bendición del sacerdocio a ese afligido padre. Mediante los susurros del Espíritu, se le prometió una paz “que sobrepasa todo entendimiento” durante esa época difícil y a lo largo de su vida.
